name: Arun Patel
bio:
Arun Patel's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a machinist in Mumbai, a chance encounter with a visiting racing team sparked a lifelong passion. He honed his skills through apprenticeships and relentless dedication, eventually specializing in chassis fabrication. His meticulous approach ensures every component meets exacting standards, contributing to the car's overall performance and safety.

Arun's ability to adapt to changing designs and tight deadlines makes him an invaluable asset. He thrives in collaborative environments, readily sharing his knowledge and experience with younger team members. His commitment to precision and his unwavering work ethic have earned him the respect of colleagues and competitors alike. Even after decades in the field, he's always looking for ways to improve.

physical.description: Arun is of average height with a sturdy build and kind eyes that reflect years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of humming traditional Indian melodies while working on complex parts.
Insists on using his own set of specialized hand tools, meticulously maintained.
